races.title: State Assembly, District 1
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Heather Hadwick
cands.bio: Republican member of the California State Assembly for District 1 since December 2024. Farmer who runs Hadwick Family Farm and Pumpkin Patch in Modoc County. Former Modoc County Sheriff's Office Deputy OES Director and Public Information Officer, former teacher, and former owner of a small local newspaper.

endorsements.text: Endorsed in the 2026 race by International Union of Operating Engineers (IUOE) Local 3, according to Ballotpedia.
Endorsed in the 2026 race by Reform California, according to Ballotpedia.

cands.gaps: We found no documented actions or stated positions from Hadwick on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, H-1B or immigration enforcement, policing pay and penalties, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. Her campaign site pledges to suspend the gas tax and says she will advocate for wildfire prevention, but those are not among the topics we track. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026. We found no documented controversies and no foreign ties in the pages reviewed. Details of her bills and their outcomes were not available beyond a general summary on Wikipedia.

local.label: Roots 100: Ballotpedia lists her birthplace as Dorris, CA, and her campaign site says she was raised in Dorris, in Siskiyou County, and now farms in Modoc County.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Has been a California Assemblymember since December 2024. Before that she was Modoc County's Deputy OES Director and Sheriff's Office Public Information Officer for almost five years, a school safety staffer at the county office of education, a teacher, a local newspaper owner, a family farm owner, and president of a local school board.
qual.why: She has legislative experience from one term in office. She also has business ownership and management experience and emergency-management work for a county government. Committee seats were not counted toward the score.

cands.name: Dianna Margaret James
cands.bio: Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 1 in 2026. She finished second in the June 2, 2026 primary with 38.5% and advanced to the November general election against incumbent Heather Hadwick (R).

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as recommended by four Sway voting groups: CrowdSourceCarrie Voting Guide, Human Decency, Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy, and Yaysayers. These are voter-guide recommendations, not organizational endorsements.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Dianna James was born or raised, or when she came to California. We also found no record of her work history, education or any offices held, so her job background is unknown. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and we found no documented positions or actions from her on data centers, development, taxes, housing, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We found no controversies or foreign ties.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.
